prompt.zh-TW: 月底，小山咖啡的帳上有下面幾個項目。哪些是負債，也就是店將來要付給別人的錢？
prompt.en: At month end, Hillside Coffee has the items below in its books. Which of them are liabilities, that is, money the shop will have to pay to others?

text.zh-TW: 還沒付給豆商的進貨款
text.en: The bean supplier's invoice that has not been paid yet

feedback.zh-TW: 是負債。貨已經收到、錢還沒付，這就是應付帳款。
feedback.en: A liability. The beans have arrived but the money has not been paid, so this is a trade payable.

text.zh-TW: 向銀行借、一年內要還的款項
text.en: A bank loan that must be repaid within a year

feedback.zh-TW: 是負債。短期借款要在一年內還給銀行。
feedback.en: A liability. Short-term borrowings must be repaid to the bank within a year.

text.en: The share capital Ching put in

feedback.zh-TW: 不是負債。股本是股東自己出的錢，店不必償還，屬於股東權益。
feedback.en: Not a liability. Share capital is the owner's own money and does not have to be repaid, so it is equity.

text.zh-TW: 架上還沒賣出的咖啡豆
text.en: The coffee beans still on the shelf

feedback.zh-TW: 不是負債。豆子是店擁有的存貨，屬於資產。
feedback.en: Not a liability. The beans are inventory the shop owns, so they are an asset.

explanation.zh-TW: 負債的判斷標準是「將來要付給別人」。{{option:o_h5sv}}與{{option:o_yzk9}}都是店欠別人的錢，所以都是負債。{{option:o_per2}}不必償還，是股東權益；{{option:o_7n4m}}是店擁有的東西，是資產。
explanation.en: The test for a liability is "will have to be paid to someone else". {{option:o_h5sv}} and {{option:o_yzk9}} are both owed by the shop, so both are liabilities. {{option:o_per2}} never has to be repaid, so it is equity; {{option:o_7n4m}} is something the shop owns, so it is an asset.
